_doc: Revision log of the ST185-harness drawing set (every harness of the car) (DECISIONS R200): DRAWN = the BY of Rev A and never changes; every BY is the initials of the person who REQUESTED the change (from %USERPROFILE%\.drawing-initials), never an agent or tool name. .01 clerical revs are not rows here (git history only). A full-letter rev from Rev B on lists what changed in `marks` (the rev triangle goes next to each).
title: ST185-harness - every wiring harness of the car, one drawing set
